title: Device ack (iot/{site}/{sourceId}/{deviceId}/ack)
description: Device-reported outcome for one command. Late acks for expired or already-settled commands are accepted by the broker but dropped by the registry — they never resurrect a settled row.

status.description: acked = executed successfully; failed = refused or errored (including expired-before-execution). delivered/expired are backend-settled statuses and must never appear here.
